description: This file is a PHP source code for the ListView component of a module in vtiger CRM. It handles listing records, applying filters, sorting, pagination, and rendering the list view template with Smarty.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine customized for vtiger CRM to render views.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Handles custom view configurations for listing records in modules.

classes.name: $currentModule
classes.description: Represents the current module being listed; dynamically instantiated and used to generate queries and view data.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks for available buttons/actions for the module.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab or category of the current module.

methods.name: getUserslist
methods.description: Returns a list of users for owner change options.

methods.name: getGroupslist
methods.description: Returns a list of groups for ownership change options.

methods.name: getWhereCondition
methods.description: Generates SQL WHERE conditions based on current context or filters.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into parts based on a delimiter.

methods.name: getListQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query to fetch list records for the current module.

methods.name: getTableNameForField
methods.description: Returns the table name associated with a given field in the module.

methods.name: mkCountQuery
methods.description: Generates a SQL COUNT query from the main list query.

methods.name: getTableHeaderNavigation
methods.description: Generates HTML for table header navigation controls.

methods.name: getListViewHeader
methods.description: Builds the header row for the list view.

methods.name: getListViewEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the list entries to display.

methods.name: getAdvSearchfields
methods.description: Provides the fields available for advanced search.
